name: LAPCO Factory Outlet Store
old_description: LIQUIDATION SALE on Red & Royal DH Products! Call for Availability
about:
LAPCO Factory Outlet Store operates in Morgan City, Louisiana, as the direct retail outlet for Lapco-branded flame-resistant workwear. The company sells factory seconds—garments with minor imperfections or sizing deviations that fall short of first-quality standards—alongside discontinued styles from the main retail line. No founding year or ownership details are disclosed in public sources.

The outlet stocks a range of FR apparel including jeans, shirts, jackets, and steel-toe boots. Products feature fabrics such as 10-ounce cotton denim, 7-ounce UltraSoft AC, 5-ounce Tecasafe® One inherent blends, and 6-ounce Tecasafe® Plus knits. Items are sold individually at marked-down prices; the website lists dozens of SKUs with regular and sale pricing. Facility size, headcount, and annual volume are not published.

The store serves industrial workers and safety managers seeking cost-effective FR protection. Typical end users include oilfield, electrical utility, and construction personnel who accept cosmetic flaws in exchange for lower cost. The outlet explicitly markets to “anyone looking for a great deal or who doesn't mind fixing a minor flaw.”

The business model centers on diverting sub-standard but wearable garments from waste streams, offering them at a fraction of first-quality price. The company emphasizes that all items are genuine Lapco products that simply failed final inspection or were phased out.
